review.notes: Machine-drafted by an AI model; awaiting native-speaker review. House style: moderate Bokmål with three genders (ei/-a for feminine nouns, en/-en masculine, et/-et neuter), weak past in -et, neuter definite plural in -ene, sju and tjue, "ble", "ga". "skal" here means a plan or an arrangement ("we are going to"), not "shall". Egg is neuter: "egg" (plural indefinite), "eggene" (definite).

sentences.text: I dag er det lørdag. Lars og Sam skal handle.
sentences.english: Today it is Saturday. Lars and Sam are going shopping.

sentences.text: På søndag har vi middag hjemme. Marta og Nils kommer. Anna lager fisk og poteter.
sentences.english: On Sunday we have dinner at home. Marta and Nils are coming. Anna makes fish and potatoes.

sentences.text: Lars har ei liste.
sentences.english: Lars has a list.

sentences.text: Det er mye på listen. Vi trenger brød, melk, egg og smør.
sentences.english: There is a lot on the list. We need bread, milk, eggs and butter.
sentences.speaker: luis

sentences.text: Vi trenger fisk og poteter også.
sentences.english: We need fish and potatoes too.
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Ja, og ost.
sentences.english: Yes, and cheese.
sentences.speaker: luis

sentences.text: De går til butikken.
sentences.english: They go to the shop.

sentences.text: Butikken er ikke stor, men mange folk handler her.
sentences.english: The shop is not big, but many people shop here.

sentences.text: Hvor er eggene?
sentences.english: Where are the eggs?
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: De er her. Hvor mye koster de?
sentences.english: They are here. How much do they cost?
sentences.speaker: luis

sentences.text: Det er dyrt, men vi trenger det.
sentences.english: That is expensive, but we need it.
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Her er smør. Smøret er ikke dyrt.
sentences.english: Here is butter. The butter is not expensive.
sentences.speaker: luis

sentences.text: Bra! Vi tar det.
sentences.english: Good! We will take it.
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Vi skal ha fisk på søndag. Hvor er fisken?
sentences.english: We are going to have fish on Sunday. Where is the fish?
sentences.speaker: luis

sentences.text: Fisken er her. Den er billig i dag!
sentences.english: The fish is here. It is cheap today!
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Poteter skal vi ha også.
sentences.english: Potatoes we shall have too.
sentences.speaker: luis

sentences.text: Nå har vi handlet. Jeg har mat på listen.
sentences.english: Now we have shopped. I have food on the list.
sentences.speaker: luis

sentences.text: Lars betaler, og Sam og Lars går hjem.
sentences.english: Lars pays, and Sam and Lars go home.

sentences.text: Anna er hjemme. Hun er glad.
sentences.english: Anna is at home. She is happy.

sentences.text: Har du mat, Lars?
sentences.english: Do you have food, Lars?
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: Ja, vi har brød, melk og ost. Vi har fisk også.
sentences.english: Yes, we have bread, milk and cheese. We have fish too.
sentences.speaker: luis

sentences.text: Har du egg?
sentences.english: Do you have eggs?
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: Ja, vi har egg. Butikken er bra!
sentences.english: Yes, we have eggs. The shop is good!
sentences.speaker: luis

sentences.text: Bra! Jeg lager middag på søndag. Jeg trenger poteter.
sentences.english: Good! I am making dinner on Sunday. I need potatoes.
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: Vi har poteter også.
sentences.english: We have potatoes too.
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Takk, Sam! Du er snill.
sentences.english: Thanks, Sam! You are kind.
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: Unnskyld, hvor er butikken?
sentences.english: Excuse me, where is the shop?
sentences.speaker: luis

sentences.text: Gå rett fram og til høyre. Bussen stopper i sentrum.
sentences.english: Go straight ahead and to the right. The bus stops in the town centre.
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Uka er lang. På mandag, tirsdag og onsdag er Anna trøtt. Hver uke ber Sam om fred.
sentences.english: The week is long. On Monday, Tuesday and Wednesday Anna is tired. Every week Sam prays for peace.

sentences.text: Telefonen til Lars er borte. Han leter, og den ligger under bordet.
sentences.english: Lars's phone is gone. He looks, and it is under the table.

sentences.text: Sam besøker Marta i dag. Det er et bra besøk.
sentences.english: Sam visits Marta today. It is a good visit.
